name: Beltane (Sun)
category: Jon Brazer Enterprises – Domains and Subdomains
body:
Associated Domain: Sun.

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the nimbus of light power of the Sun domain.

Bonfire Dance (Su): At 6th level, you can channel the energy of the sacred bonfires into a powerful dance, granting you and your allies within a 30-foot radius protection for a number of rounds per day equal to your cleric level. You and your allies within this radius gain a +1 deflection bonus to AC and resistance 5 against cold. The deflection bonus increases by +1 for every four cleric levels you possess beyond 8th. At 14th level, the resistance against cold increases to 10. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.

Replacement Domain Spells: 2nd—snapdragon fireworks, 6th—fire seeds.
